title: Fire in the Lower Town
text: A chandler's shop went up at midnight and the wind did the rest. Three streets are ash. The survivors say the fire walked from house to house, and knocked first.

triumph.text: The streets rise again within the Year, and the people bless the Houses by name.

holds.text: Shelters, soup, and slow rebuilding. Nobody will light a candle in the new houses.

falters.text: The burned-out families drift away to other cities, and take the story of the knocking fire with them.

calamity.text: In the Year's end gales the fire walks again, and this time it knocks on a House's door.
